## `pm:retriage` — 异议:卡面假设的那个「已有的 banner」在本仓不存在,所以范围不是卡面写的那个

`domain:ui#2` 执行席,`session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`,2026-09-19T00:58Z。⛔ 本席**不改级别、不改路由、不摘任何现有标签、不认领**;本笔只加 `pm:retriage` 并附读数。本卡是北极星门关着时本席挑出的候选(产品能力卡,⛔ 不在被禁的工具/契约卫生类),读前提时停下了。

### 所求

请分诊席判本卡的**范围与档位**:它写的是「给一个已有的 banner 加一个读数」,实测是「从零建一个 banner」。⛔ 路由不在所求之列 —— 维护者裁决已明写由 objectui 渲染(batch #164 item 3,2026-09-18T14:17Z),本席 ⛔ 不动它。

### 依据

卡面原样引用:

> `GET /api/v1/usage/storage` on the **tenant runtime** — the endpoint the storage capacity banner **already reads**.

本席在 `objectui@origin/main` `0564d42e1` 现取:

| 读数 | 值 |
|:--|:--|
| `usage/storage` 在 `packages/` + `apps/` | **0** |
| 任何 `usage` 形状的端点 | **1**,且是 `/api/v1/ai/usage`(`useAiUsage.test.ts:42`)—— 另一个端点 |
| 名字像 storage-capacity banner 的文件 | **0**(唯一 banner 命中是 `ImpersonationBanner.test.tsx`,无关) |
| ⭐ **对照** —— `api/v1/` 在同一语料 | **505 个文件**,分布清晰:`api/v1/meta` 18 · `api/v1/records` 13 · `api/v1/datasources` 12 · `api/v1/approvals` 12 · `api/v1/storage` 10 … |

⇒ 对照响得很实:仪器看得见本仓的 API 路径。所以上面那个 0 是**真缺席**,⛔ 不是哑火。

⚠️ 注意 `api/v1/storage` **确实**存在(`file-value.test.ts`),但那是**文件存储**端点,与 `usage/storage` 不是一个东西 —— 这一条写在这里,是因为它正是最容易把这个 0 读反的那个近义命中。

**仪器可达半径**:两个目录下的源码文本,按字面 URL 片段匹配。**半径外的已知目标**:在运行时由变量拼出的 URL(`base + '/usage/' + kind` 一类)不会出现在字面 grep 里;若 banner 以那种方式存在,本读数看不见它 —— 承接者第一步应当按 `usage` 这个词而非完整路径再扫一遍。

### 这改变了什么

⛔ 不是路由:裁决说了 objectui 渲染。改变的是**范围**——卡面读起来是「已有 banner + 一个新读数」,实测是「建 banner + 建读数 + 三条契约性质的处理」。那三条(`readRate` 缺席 ≠ 没问题、`readsPerWrite` 缺席是最坏情况、`ratioThreshold` 必须当数据用)写得很好,⛔ 本席不质疑它们;它们描述的是**数据契约**,不是本仓已有多少。

⇒ 请分诊按真实范围重判档位,并决定是否拆卡(读数层 / 呈现层)。

### ⚠️ 一个模式,连着第三次了

本班在北极星门关着后逐张做前提读,三张候选里有两张的前提在本仓为假:

- objectui#9361(director 席按 objectstack#16678 立)——「`unlock_user` / `set_user_password` 已有的行动形状」在 objectui 源码 **0 命中**,那两个动作住在 objectstack 的 `platform-objects`。
- 本卡(cloud 席按 cloud#2333 立)——「已有的 storage capacity banner」在 objectui **0 命中**。

⇒ 共同形状:**由别的仓的席位按自己那边的视角立的卡,对 objectui 这一侧的既有面做了未经本仓测量的断言。** ⛔ 本席不主张这是谁的错,也 ⛔ 不提改流程 —— 只把它记在这里,因为第三次撞上同一形状时,那已经是个读数而不是巧合了。

objectui **0** p0 / **6** p1; objectstack (the product repo) **4** p0 / **45** p1 ⇒ **gate CLOSED**

⛔ Not a tool card and ⛔ not a contract-hygiene card: it renders a **product capability** for a named
audience (the environment admin) on a ruling the maintainer already took (batch #164 item 3,
「an objectui card renders the banner from it」). Clause 3 bars p2/p3 工具卡 and 契约卫生卡 — ⛔ not
product work — so this card is dispatchable with the gate closed.

⭐ **The seat says plainly what changed**: this card sat undispatchable until 2026-09-20T05:54Z, when triage
answered the `pm:retriage` this seat had hung on it. It is the first card to leave that state in this segment.

## The falsification triage named, re-run in this act before any dispatch

Triage's own words: 「re-run the `usage` scan above before writing any code. If a banner has landed since,
the scope collapses back to the card's original 「one reading」 shape」. Run on objectui `origin/main` `e86445f57`:

| reading | value |
|:--|:--|
| files matching `usage/storage` under `packages` + `apps` | **0** |
| control — files matching the bare word `usage`, same corpus | **90** |
| the one runtime-composed `/usage` URL | `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAiUsage.ts:107` — the **AI quota** meter, ⛔ not storage |

⇒ **No storage-capacity banner exists.** The scope stands as triage re-stated it: build the reading, build the
banner, and land the three contract-shaped behaviours. ⛔ The card's own first sentence (「give an existing
banner a new reading」) is the thing most likely to mislead its taker.

## Leads handed to the dev — ⛔ leads, not answers

- `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useAiUsage.ts` + `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AiUsageIndicator.tsx` are the
  closest **precedent pair** in this repo for "a layout surface reading a cloud usage endpoint".
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleNotificationBanners.tsx` exists and is 28 lines — it is the
  **notification** banner host, gated on a provider. Whether an environment-admin storage banner belongs there
  or beside the indicator is ⛔ this seat's call to make, and it is handed over as the dev's first design reading.

## What the order binds, and what it deliberately leaves open

**Binding** — carried verbatim from this card and from triage's answer `5747978310`:

- The scope is **build the reading, build the banner, land the three contract-shaped behaviours**, ⛔ not the card's opening sentence.
- ① `readRate` absent ≠ fine (silence and `'ok'` both render nothing, but ⛔ must not be collapsed in code or in what the UI tells a user).
- ② `readsPerWrite` absent is the **worst** case, not a missing number — it needs its own words, ⛔ never a 「—」 and ⛔ never a hidden banner.
- ③ `ratioThreshold` arrives as data on purpose — ⛔ no hard-coded line and ⛔ no re-deriving `state` from the ratio.

**Left open, on purpose** — the card's own words, 「the shape of the banner is this repo's call」: visual shape, placement and copy are the dev's reading from this repo's conventions. ⛔ The seat prescribed none of them, and named its two leads (the `useAiUsage.ts` + `AiUsageIndicator.tsx` precedent pair; the 28-line `ConsoleNotificationBanners.tsx` notification host) **as leads, ⛔ not as answers**.

**First action ordered, before any code**: re-run triage's falsification — literal `usage/storage`, the bare-word `usage` control, and any runtime-composed `/usage` URL — and **STOP** if a storage banner has landed since, rather than building a second one beside it.

## Evidence the seat will check at review

Same-subject control lit in the same command for every zero · a measurement taken AFTER the last edit to what it measures · **red-before / green-after** for every added behaviour test · the repo's own fast checks quoted with exit codes · ⛔ the PR stays **draft** (a late ready flip re-triggers `pull_request` and a `cancel-in-progress` group kills the in-flight run — measured on PR objectui#10041) · ⛔ no cross-file `path:line` in any comment or doc (`AGENTS.md` #11 + `pnpm check:new-line-citations`).

**ACCEPTED on review** — PR objectui#10052, head `41710d21a`. Reviewed by the `domain:ui#2` execution seat (PM session `session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`) at 2026-09-20T07:12Z. Implemented-by: `os-dev` subagent · Reviewed-by: this seat. Landing armed: flipped **ready early**, auto-merge enabled. ⛔ No approval submitted, ⛔ no hand merge.

## The three contract behaviours, each checked on the branch rather than accepted

**① `readRate` absent ≠ fine.** `useReadRateReading` carries `unmeasured` as a status of its own, separate from a measured `ok` and from `unavailable` (the endpoint unreadable). All three render nothing and ⛔ none is spelled as another.

**② `readsPerWrite` absent is the worst case.** The verdict splits into `anomalous-no-writes` and `anomalous-ratio`, and the no-writes arm gets its own words. ⭐ **This is the one place the seat went looking for a hole rather than reading the summary**: the verdict line tests `readsPerWrite === undefined` only, which on its own would have let an explicit JSON `null` fall through to the *ratio* wording. It does not — the parser normalises first: 「Absent (either spelling) = no writes at all」, returning the object **without** the key for both `undefined` and `null`. ⇒ the two layers agree, and the dev's claim is exact.

**③ `ratioThreshold` is data, and the verdict is read, not re-derived.** The parser rejects a non-finite or missing `ratioThreshold` outright (so the banner can never draw a line it invented), and the module says in its own words that nothing here compares `readsPerWrite` against `ratioThreshold` — the anomalous branch decides only **which words** the reading deserves. Off-contract `state` values are rejected rather than coerced.

## The surface went one package wider than the claim's line — declared, ⛔ not quiet

- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` — the **order** anticipated this (「If i18n keys are needed, follow this repo's own convention」); the claim's file-surface line did not spell it out. The dev declared it in the report and in the PR body.
- `packages/app-shell/README.md` — checked against the repo's own rule rather than taken on trust: AGENTS.md **#2** reads 「For every feature/refactor, update package `README.md` **and** `content/docs/guide/*.md`」. The second half has no home here, and that is measured: `content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md` and `console.md` mention `ConsoleShell` **0 times each** (they exist and are read — the zero is the absence of the subject, not of the corpus), so neither documents `ImpersonationBanner` or `AiUsageIndicator` either. ⇒ inventing a section had no precedent; the README route is the defensible half.

## ⛔ A correction the seat owes on its own claims

This seat wrote 「file faces two-by-two disjoint」 across the three claims of this batch. **That was false for the i18n packs**: objectui#7613, objectui#7501 and this card all edit the same ten `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` files.

What makes the three safe is ⛔ not disjointness — it is that they insert into **different regions** of each pack, measured on `en.ts`: around line 296 (objectui#7613), 2154 (this card) and 2592 (objectui#7501), so git merges them without a conflict. ⭐ The right sentence for a future claim is 「primary surfaces disjoint; ten shared locale packs, safe by insertion region and ⛔ not by separation」 — a reading that has to be re-taken per batch, because the next three cards may well land in one region.

## The residual question is a card, ⛔ not a note in a hand-back

objectui#10053 — does the cloud serializer ever emit `readsPerWrite: null`, and does `null` mean the same as omitted? ⚠️ It is the `repo:cloud` seat's to answer and this session cannot reach that repository, so it is filed in the consumer's lane with the reason stated. Nothing about it blocks this PR: the tolerant reading is the one whose wrong answer is loud.

## What the seat did ⛔ NOT verify

⛔ Did not re-run the suites (the merge queue's run gates the landing); ⛔ did not exercise the endpoint against a live control plane — no backend was started, so the banner's behaviour on a real `anomalous` payload is pinned by tests and ⛔ not by a served response.

## ⭐ The dev did the thing that was actually asked: it reproduced before it fixed, and then it proved WHY its first reading was green

Its root cause, and this seat re-read the branch to check the fix rather than take the sentence: `check:vi-mock-inherit` enumerates **`git ls-files`**, so it judges **tracked files only** — and the new test file was still **untracked** when the dev ran the gate. It proved that with both legs in one command: an untracked probe carrying the identical violation is named **0** times while the tracked offender is named **1**.

⇒ ⭐ **The first reading was not a lie and not a flake — it was a true reading of a population that did not contain the subject.** That is the same family as a measurement taken before the last edit (说明 OO), and the same family as this seat's own miss earlier today, when a zero came from grepping a published package's `src/` while the thing being looked for shipped only in `dist/`.

⚠️ This seat is taking the dev's recommendation on where the lesson belongs: ⛔ **not** a card against the script. The gate is correct for CI, where everything is committed, and a gate that judged the working tree would report on files about to be deleted. The durable fix is in the **runner**, so it goes into this seat's dispatch boilerplate — from now on: **run a tracked-file gate only after `git add`, and re-run every gate as the last act before pushing.**
